desc: A hamster-like creature whose whole body is stitched damp brown carpet, button eyes, one short fluorescent tube sticking out of its back, wallpaper patch ears. Not a normal animal: a Backrooms anomaly creature, still small and pet-like, chibi 2-head-tall, right-facing 3/4 view, full body centered, clean pixel art, flat 3-tone shading, single dark outline, no ground shadow, no particles.
